name: Cockatiel
legal_note: Fictional Forbidden-Memories-style character. The name is only the bird; it uses no real person's name, face, voice or catchphrases.
role: Optional wandering duelist, Temple Crossroads, from chapter 6 on (stage 7+). Story script ids: side_cockatiel_pre / _win / _lose / _done / _epilogue.
bio: A bird tamer who walks from oasis to oasis with a flock that follows the wind. Speaks in cheerful chirps, hates losing, never hurts a bird. The little cockatiel on the shoulder is called Pip and only talks when it wants snacks.
personality: a little vain about the crest
portrait_description: Bust portrait, 48x48 final (draw at 192x192). A lean young traveler with a tall swept-up crest of yellow-blond hair like a bird crest, two round orange cheek marks painted on the face, a grey-and-yellow feathered cloak over a sand-colored tunic, a small grey cockatiel with a yellow face and orange cheek patch perched on the left shoulder. Big confident grin, one eyebrow raised. Palette: warm yellow, soft grey, orange, sand. Style: matches the game's hand-painted PS1 duelist portraits, 64 colors, dark outline, plain dark background. No text, no logos, not a likeness of any real person.
model_hint: Quaternius Hoodie or Punk character, yellow-tinted hair, plus a tiny grey bird prop on the shoulder (CC0).

port_duelist.note: copy gives AI and drop pools; deck is replaced by decks.json['Cockatiel'] (fixed 40).

play_style: Fast Winged Beasts and Wind Dragons; plays Mountain early. Weak to Raigeki and to high-DEF walls.
